classification_algorithm: Pin selected source bytes independently; AST identifies definitions, functions, source callsites and lexical parents without executing them.
Definition means AST module/class code only; ordinary function with scalar assignments may be typed scalar from body text but descendants and native calls require separate analysis.
Device means directly identified hardware API request, not CUDA-prefixed module name. No observed hardware event exists in this static stage.
Imports, hook dispatch, unknown state-dependent branches, native initializers or required unavailable C arguments remain unknown and refuse.
Numeric runtime code flags, actual frame path/line/parent and executable frozen-code correspondence are UNAVAILABLE/UNMEASURED; AST source line/type is not runtime qualification.
Independent post-observation typing, if later authorized, cannot rewrite frozen permission decisions.
